results.test: 1. Blocked poses never appear in working poses (all 8 injury types)
2. Safety bias: structural injuries cap maxBand=1, soft-tissue cap maxBand=2
3. Any injury reduces effectiveDifficulty by exactly −0.07 (flat, not per-tag)
4. Multiple injuries: strictest band cap wins; −0.07 difficulty penalty does not compound
5. Empty tags → no poses blocked, no difficulty penalty, no band cap
6. Sessions remain valid (13 poses, no duplicates) across all 8 injury types
